title: Australia & New Zealand Grand Tour
subtitle: 46 Days: Sydney, New Zealand, Queensland, Northern Territory, South Australia, Victoria & Tasmania
description: An extraordinary 46-day journey across two countries — from Sydney's harbour to Auckland's volcanoes, Wellington's cafés to the Great Barrier Reef, the ancient Uluru to the wild Tasmanian wilderness. A trip that touches Australia's soul: its landscapes, its people, its Indigenous heritage, and the personal meaning of a great grandfather's grave in Auckland. Vegetarian-friendly throughout, budget-conscious, and packed with the must-see moments of a lifetime.
bestFor: Couples, adventure travellers, vegetarians, culture lovers, nature seekers
highlights: Sydney Harbour — Opera House, Harbour Bridge walk, and Bondi to Coogee
Blue Mountains — Three Sisters and ancient rainforest
Auckland, New Zealand — volcanoes, Rangitoto Island, and a deeply personal grave visit
Wellington — Te Papa, Weta Workshop, and the coolest café culture in the world
Byron Bay and Yamba — east coast beach towns and family connections
Great Barrier Reef — snorkelling the world's largest coral ecosystem
Uluru and Kata Tjuta — the Red Centre at sunrise and sunset
Kakadu National Park — 20,000-year-old Aboriginal rock art and crocodiles
Adelaide, Barossa Valley, and McLaren Vale — food and wine paradise
Great Ocean Road — Twelve Apostles and the most dramatic coastal drive in Australia
Melbourne — street art, world-class coffee, and the Moroccan Soup Bar
Tasmania — MONA, Port Arthur, Freycinet, and friends & family
Daintree Rainforest — oldest on Earth, where the rainforest meets the reef

essentials.title: 🗺️ The Route
essentials.text: Sydney (3 days) → Auckland NZ (3 days) → Wellington NZ including conference (6 days) → Byron Bay & Yamba (4 days) → Queensland Coast (5 days: Sunshine Coast, Whitsundays, Great Barrier Reef) → Cairns & Daintree (2 days) → Darwin & Northern Territory (5 days: Litchfield, Kakadu, Uluru) → Adelaide & surrounds (3 days) → Great Ocean Road (2 days) → Melbourne (2 days) → Tasmania (5 days) → Return Sydney (2 days)

essentials.title: 🌿 Vegetarian Australia
essentials.text: Australia is incredibly vegetarian-friendly — especially in cities. Sydney's Newtown, Melbourne's Fitzroy, and Byron Bay are vegetarian paradises. Outback areas (Kakadu, Uluru) have limited options — always carry snacks. The markets (Salamanca, Adelaide Central, Airlie, Mindil Beach) have excellent vegetarian stalls. Ask for 'veggie option' at any pub — halloumi burgers and mushroom dishes are now standard. Outside major cities, always confirm ahead.

essentials.title: 💰 Budget Reality — $2-5k/person
essentials.text: This budget is achievable with smart choices. Flight costs are significant — shop Jetstar/Tigerair domestically, book 3-4 weeks ahead. Accommodation: hostels $30-50/night, Airbnb $60-120, motels $80-150. Many highlights are free: coastal walks, beaches, national park lookouts, markets. Big ticket items to budget for: Great Barrier Reef trip ($200-250), Scenic World Katoomba ($53), Weta Workshop ($49), Zealandia ($24), Kakadu park pass ($40), Port Arthur ($45). National Parks: buy passes upfront.

essentials.title: 🚗 Getting Around
essentials.text: For the coastal leg (Byron to Cairns), renting a car gives maximum flexibility. Queensland to Darwin is a fly (don't drive — it's 3,000 km of nothing). Adelaide → Melbourne: Great Ocean Road requires a car. In cities: Opal card (Sydney), Myki (Melbourne), AT HOP (Auckland), Snapper card (Wellington). Between cities: Jetstar and Virgin Australia are the budget choices. Book flights 3-6 weeks ahead for best prices.

essentials.title: 🌡️ May–June Weather
essentials.text: Autumn in southern Australia (mild, 12-22°C in Sydney/Melbourne), and dry season beginning in the north. Darwin in May is coming out of the wet — hot (30°C) and humid with afternoon storms possible. Uluru in May/June is perfect: 20°C days, cold nights. Tasmania in June can be cold (5-12°C) with possible snow at altitude. Queensland and Cairns: beautiful and warm (25-28°C). Pack layers for the south and light, breathable clothes for the tropics.

essentials.title: 🐊 Wildlife & Safety
essentials.text: Crocodiles: NEVER swim in unmarked waterways in the NT and North QLD. Signs mean something. Stingers (jellyfish): stinger suits or swim in netted areas Oct-May in North QLD. Dingoes on Fraser Island: keep 5m distance, never feed, never turn your back. Snakes: most are non-aggressive, but watch where you step in bush. If bitten: compression bandage, don't wash the wound, call 000. Sharks: swim between the flags at patrolled beaches. Australia's wildlife is extraordinary but must be respected.

activities.title: 🌊 Florence Falls
activities.description: Swim in a plunge pool at the base of twin waterfalls. The walk down through vine forest is beautiful.
details: 💡 Buley Rockhole nearby — series of natural spa pools

activities.title: 🐜 Magnetic Termite Mounds
activities.description: Hundreds of 2m-tall tombstone-shaped mounds, all aligned north-south to regulate temperature. Mind-blowing natural engineering.

meals.name: Darwin
meals.description: Early start with packed snacks.

meals.name: Packed Lunch
meals.description: Bring food — limited options in the park.

meals.name: Darwin — Hanuman
meals.description: Outstanding Thai/Indian in Darwin. Exceptional vegetarian menu.

tips.text: 💡 Croc safety is REAL in the NT. Never swim in unmarked waterways. Check signs at every swimming hole.

days.title: Kakadu National Park — Day 1
days.description: Australia's largest national park. Aboriginal rock art 20,000+ years old, wetlands teeming with wildlife, and landscapes that are genuinely unlike anywhere else on Earth.

activities.title: 🚗 Darwin → Kakadu
activities.description: ~3 hours east. Enter Kakadu — Aboriginal-owned, jointly managed.
details: 💡 Kakadu is Aboriginal land — respect is paramount

meals.name: Darwin
meals.description: Early start.

activities.title: 🎨 Ubirr Rock Art
activities.description: One of Australia's most significant Aboriginal art sites. Paintings spanning 20,000+ years — creation stories, animals, contact-era depictions of Europeans. The sunset lookout above is otherworldly.
details: 🌅 Sunset from the top is a spiritual experience
💡 The X-ray style art (showing internal organs) is unique to this region

activities.title: 🐊 Cahills Crossing
activities.description: Famous saltwater crocodile viewing spot where crocs gather at the river crossing. You will see enormous crocs.
details: 🐊 Multiple large crocs visible from viewing area

meals.name: Kakadu — Border Store
meals.description: Basic supplies and takeaway near Ubirr.

meals.name: Cooinda Lodge
meals.description: Kakadu's main accommodation hub. Restaurant with veggie options.

days.title: Kakadu — Yellow Water & Nourlangie
days.neighborhoods: Yellow Water · Nourlangie · Jim Jim Falls
days.description: Cruise among thousands of birds and crocodiles at Yellow Water, then explore Nourlangie's ancient rock art galleries.

activities.title: 🛶 Yellow Water Cruise
activities.description: Billabong cruise through wetlands teeming with birdlife — jabiru, brolga, magpie geese, sea eagles — and saltwater crocs lurking at the water's edge. Sunrise cruise is magical.
details: 💡 Sunrise cruise (6:45 AM) is the best — cooler, birds most active

meals.name: Before cruise
meals.description: Early start for sunrise cruise. Light snack.

activities.title: 🎨 Nourlangie Rock Art
activities.description: Another extraordinary gallery of Aboriginal rock art. Lightning Man (Namarrgon) is the star — a creation ancestor who controls the monsoon storms.
details: 💡 Lightning Man painting is one of Kakadu's most famous images

activities.title: 💧 Jim Jim Falls (seasonal)
activities.description: In the wet season this is a thundering 200m waterfall. By May/June, it's a tranquil plunge pool — still beautiful, just different.
details: 📍 Jim Jim · 4WD access only · Check conditions
💡 May/June = end of wet, falls may still be flowing

meals.name: Cooinda
meals.description: Lodge restaurant or packed lunch.

meals.name: Jabiru
meals.description: Small town in Kakadu. Aurora Kakadu has a restaurant.

days.title: Darwin to Uluru
days.neighborhoods: Darwin → Alice Springs → Uluru-Kata Tjuta NP
days.description: Fly to Alice Springs or Uluru direct. The Red Centre — Australia's spiritual heart. Uluru rises from the flat desert like a living entity.

activities.title: ✈️ Darwin → Ayers Rock Airport (direct)
activities.description: 2-hour flight direct to Uluru (Ayers Rock Airport). Or fly Darwin → Alice → bus 5hrs. Direct flight recommended.
details: 💡 Or: Darwin → Alice Springs ($120) + 5-hr bus to Uluru

meals.name: Darwin
meals.description: Early start.

activities.title: 🪨 First Sunset at Uluru
activities.description: Nothing can prepare you for your first sight of Uluru. Drive to the sunset viewing area (Talinguru Nyakunytjaku) with a glass of sparkling wine. Watch it turn from ochre to deep red to purple.
details: 💡 The colour is breathtaking — every phone photo is inadequate
⚠️ DO NOT climb Uluru. It's permanently closed (Oct 2019). The Anangu people ask this.

meals.name: Outback Pioneer Hotel
meals.description: Limited options in Yulara. Packed lunch from resort bakery.

meals.name: Desert Gardens Hotel
meals.description: Resort restaurant. Decent vegetarian pasta and salads.

tips.text: ⚠️ DO NOT CLIMB ULURU. It was permanently closed in Oct 2019 out of respect for the Anangu people. Climbing is deeply offensive to traditional owners.

days.title: Uluru — Base Walk & Cultural Tours
days.description: Walk around the full base of Uluru (10.6 km) and discover its extraordinary layers of stories, art, and meaning. The rock is different at every angle.

activities.title: 🌅 Uluru Sunrise
activities.description: Watch the sun rise from Talinguru Nyakunytjaku. Uluru goes from black silhouette to glowing orange in minutes. Arguably the most spectacular sunrise in Australia.
details: 📍 Sunrise viewing area · FREE · Arrive 30 min before sunrise

meals.name: Packed
meals.description: Bring coffee and pastries from resort for sunrise.

activities.title: 🚶 Uluru Base Walk
activities.description: The full 10.6 km circuit takes 3-4 hours and reveals: Kantju Gorge, Mutitjulu Waterhole (sacred, ancient rock art), Kuniya Piti, and constant changing views of the monolith.
details: 📍 Full circuit 10.6 km · FREE with park pass
💡 Start at Mala Walk car park going clockwise
⚠️ Photography is restricted in some areas (signs indicate)

activities.title: 🎨 Mutitjulu Waterhole & Rock Art
activities.description: A sacred site with permanent water and ancient rock art. The art depicts the Tjukurpa (Dreaming) — creation stories that explain Uluru's features.

meals.name: Picnic
meals.description: Pack lunch and eat in shaded areas near the base.

activities.title: 🌿 Anangu Cultural Experience
activities.description: Book a guided tour with Anangu traditional owners. Learn the Tjukurpa (Dreaming), how to hunt, traditional medicine plants, and the deep spiritual significance of every feature of Uluru.
details: 💡 Hearing the Tjukurpa directly from Anangu people transforms how you see Uluru

meals.name: Sounds of Silence
meals.description: Bush tucker dinner under the stars with didgeridoo. Vegetarian options available. One of the world's great dining experiences.
meals.meta: 📍 Under the stars · 💰 $220/pp · Book well ahead

tips.text: 💡 Aboriginal astronomical knowledge is extraordinary — the 'Emu in the Sky' is a constellation made of dark patches, not stars. Anangu guides will show you.

days.title: Kata Tjuta — Valley of the Winds
days.neighborhoods: Kata Tjuta · Walpa Gorge · Kings Canyon area
days.description: Kata Tjuta (The Olgas) are, many argue, even more impressive than Uluru. Thirty-six domed rock formations, and the Valley of the Winds walk is one of Australia's great hikes.

activities.title: 🌄 Valley of the Winds Walk
activities.description: The full loop (7.4 km) winds through dramatic gorges between the domes. Karu and Karingana lookouts are jaw-dropping. The sacred men's site means you can't do the full loop, but what's open is extraordinary.
details: 📍 Kata Tjuta · FREE with park pass · 7.4 km · ~3-4 hrs
⚠️ Check closures: the walk closes at 11 AM if temperature exceeds 36°C
💡 Start at dawn — golden light and cooler temperatures

activities.title: 🪨 Walpa Gorge Walk
activities.description: Short (2.6 km) alternative that goes into a beautiful gorge between the domes.

meals.name: Early/Packed
meals.description: Sunrise start — pack breakfast.

activities.title: 🏜️ Kings Canyon (Optional Drive)
activities.description: 330 km west of Uluru. If you have the energy, the Rim Walk (6 km) around the canyon is stunning — the Garden of Eden (natural waterhole at the base) is otherworldly. Requires a car.
details: 📍 Watarrka NP · ~3.5 hrs drive from Uluru
💡 Kings Canyon Resort if staying overnight

meals.name: Packed
meals.description: Desert picnic.

meals.name: Outback BBQ at Resort
meals.description: Or Kings Canyon Resort if you've driven out.

days.title: Uluru to Adelaide
days.neighborhoods: Uluru → Adelaide · North Terrace · Central Market
days.description: Fly to South Australia's beautiful, liveable capital. Adelaide is underrated — exceptional food and wine, a vibrant arts scene, and the best central market in Australia.

activities.title: ✈️ Uluru → Adelaide
activities.description: ~2-hour flight to Adelaide.
details: 💡 Adelaide is on ACST (UTC+9:30) same as NT

meals.name: Airport or packed
meals.description: Light breakfast before flight.

activities.title: 🏛️ North Terrace — Cultural Boulevard
activities.description: Adelaide's cultural strip. The Art Gallery of SA, SA Museum (free!), State Library, and University of Adelaide all line this leafy boulevard.
details: 📍 North Terrace · FREE entry to most
💡 SA Museum has a brilliant natural history and Indigenous collection

activities.title: 🌿 Adelaide Central Market
activities.description: One of Australia's greatest food markets. Deli counters, fresh produce, cheese, coffee, and a wonderful communal atmosphere.
details: 💡 Incredible vegetarian food — multiple dedicated stalls

meals.name: Adelaide Central Market
meals.description: Graze through the market. Vegetarian options everywhere.

meals.name: Africola
meals.description: Adelaide institution. Ethiopian-inspired, heavily vegetarian-friendly menu. The injera and vegetable stews are outstanding.

days.title: Adelaide — Friends, Family & Food
days.description: Reconnect with friends and family in Adelaide. Explore the Adelaide Hills and the German village of Hahndorf.

activities.title: 🌿 Adelaide Hills Drive
activities.description: Beautiful rolling hills 30 minutes from the CBD. Apple orchards, vineyards, and charming villages. Mount Lofty summit (727m) for the view over Adelaide.
details: 💡 Cleland Wildlife Park is nearby — koalas, wombats, kangaroos

activities.title: 🏘️ Hahndorf Village
activities.description: Australia's oldest surviving German settlement. Heritage buildings, artisan shops, and bakeries. The Hahndorf Inn has been here since 1839.
details: 📍 Hahndorf · 30 min from Adelaide · FREE to explore

meals.name: Adelaide
meals.description: With friends/family.

activities.title: 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Friends & Family
activities.description: Enjoy quality time with your Adelaide connections. Let them show you their favourite spots.

meals.name: Hahndorf
meals.description: German bakeries and cafés — ask for vegetarian schnitzel (mushroom) or apple strudel.

meals.name: Friends & Family Home
meals.description: Home-cooked meal — the best kind.

days.title: Barossa Valley & McLaren Vale
days.description: Two of Australia's great wine regions. Even if wine isn't your focus, the landscapes are beautiful and the food is extraordinary.

activities.title: 🍷 Barossa Valley
activities.description: World-famous shiraz country. The vines here are among the oldest in the world. Seppeltsfield, Jacobs Creek, and Penfolds are the big names — but small producers are more interesting.
details: 💡 Seppeltsfield Centennial Wines — oldest continuous family winery in Australia
🌿 The Barossa Farmers Market (Sat morning) is excellent for vegetarian produce

meals.name: Barossa Farmers Market
meals.description: Saturday: extraordinary market produce.

activities.title: 🌊 McLaren Vale
activities.description: Stunning wine region near the sea. d'Arenberg Cube is a surreal 5-storey cube winery with incredible views.
details: 💡 d'Arenberg Cube: free to visit exterior, tours available

meals.name: McLaren Vale
meals.description: Blessed Cheese for extraordinary vegetarian cheese platters.

meals.name: Peel Street (Adelaide)
meals.description: Adelaide's best restaurant strip. Peel Street restaurant for Modern Australian vegetarian options.

days.title: Adelaide to Warrnambool
days.description: Begin the Great Ocean Road journey. Drive east through SA's Limestone Coast — dramatic sea stacks and beautiful beaches.

activities.title: 🚗 Adelaide → Robe
activities.description: ~330 km, 3.5 hours. Robe is a beautiful limestone fishing town with excellent seafood (great halloumi burgers too).
details: 💡 Beachport also worth a stop — quiet beach town

meals.name: Adelaide
meals.description: Early start.

activities.title: 🚗 Robe → Warrnambool
activities.description: Cross into Victoria. ~2.5 more hours.
details: 💡 You're now in Victoria — slightly different time zone if QLD was confusing

activities.title: 🐳 Logans Beach Whale Nursery
activities.description: Southern right whales calve here May-Oct. Viewing platform right on the beach. Free.
details: 🐳 May-Oct: southern right whales nursing calves in the shallows

meals.name: Robe
meals.description: Fish & chips or vegetarian burger.

meals.name: Warrnambool — Fishtales
meals.description: Great vegetarian options at this popular restaurant.

days.title: Great Ocean Road — West
days.neighborhoods: Port Campbell · Twelve Apostles · Loch Ard Gorge
days.description: The most spectacular coastal drive in Australia. The Twelve Apostles rise from the Southern Ocean like ancient sentinels. Start from the western end — fewer crowds.

activities.title: 🪨 Twelve Apostles
activities.description: Limestone stacks rising up to 45m from the ocean. Only 8 remain (they collapse over time). Sunrise is the best time — golden light, fewer tourists.
details: 💡 Go to the eastern viewing platform, not just the main area

activities.title: 🏴‍☠️ Loch Ard Gorge
activities.description: Named after the ship that wrecked here in 1878. Two survivors clung to the rock walls. Now a beautiful gorge with a sheltered beach.

meals.name: Packed
meals.description: Early start for sunrise. Coffee from Port Campbell afterwards.

activities.title: 🌊 The Grotto, London Arch & Bay of Islands
activities.description: A series of extraordinary rock formations along a short stretch of coast. The Grotto is a collapsed sea cave with a sinkhole view to the ocean.

activities.title: 🌿 Otways Rainforest
activities.description: Stop at the Otways (Maits Rest Rainforest Walk — 30 min, free) for ancient myrtle beech rainforest. Koalas frequently spotted.

meals.name: Port Campbell
meals.description: Café in the small township.

meals.name: Apollo Bay
meals.description: Beautiful bay town. Bay Leaf Café for vegetarian-friendly dinner.

days.title: Great Ocean Road to Melbourne
days.description: Drive the rest of the Great Ocean Road through surf country. Arrive in Melbourne — Australia's cultural capital.

activities.title: 🌊 Torquay & Bells Beach
activities.description: Torquay is the surf capital of Australia — home to Rip Curl and Quiksilver. Bells Beach is the world's most famous surf break.
details: 🏄 Bells Beach: surfing only — no swimming, powerful waves

activities.title: 🚗 Drive to Melbourne
activities.description: ~1.5 hours into the city from Torquay.

meals.name: Apollo Bay or Lorne
meals.description: Beautiful cafés on the coast.

activities.title: 🎨 Hosier Lane & Street Art
activities.description: Melbourne's famous graffiti laneway. Layers of world-class street art by local and international artists. It changes constantly.

activities.title: ☕ Melbourne Coffee Culture
activities.description: Melbourne's café culture is a serious religion. Hardware Société, Brother Baba Budan, Patricia Coffee. Single-origin, pour-over, the works.
details: 💡 Asking for a 'large coffee' will get you a look. Order by type.

meals.name: Lorne
meals.description: Stop for lunch on the coast.

meals.name: Moroccan Soup Bar (Melbourne)
meals.description: Legendary vegetarian restaurant. BYOB, full of food, $30 flat. Book ahead — always packed.
meals.meta: 📍 183 St Georges Rd, Fitzroy · 💰 $30 flat vegetarian feast

days.title: Melbourne — Culture & Neighbourhoods
days.description: Melbourne's inner suburbs are where Australian culture is being made. Street art, Vietnamese food, live music, bookshops, and coffee at every turn.

activities.title: 📚 Fitzroy & Smith Street
activities.description: Melbourne's hippest corridor. Vintage stores, record shops, bookshops, and the densest concentration of good coffee in the Southern Hemisphere.
details: 📍 Smith St / Johnston St, Fitzroy · FREE

activities.title: 🌿 Carlton Gardens & Museum
activities.description: Stroll through Carlton Gardens (UNESCO), then visit Melbourne Museum — excellent Indigenous galleries and natural history.

meals.name: Fitzroy Café
meals.description: Proud Mary or St Ali for exceptional coffee and vegetarian brunch.

activities.title: 🏛️ National Gallery of Victoria (NGV)
activities.description: Australia's most visited art museum. International collection in the main building (free), Australian art across the river. Incredible architecture.
details: 📍 180 St Kilda Rd · FREE international collection

activities.title: 🎭 Southbank Promenade
activities.description: Walk along the Yarra River. Buskers, restaurants, and the Arts Precinct.

meals.name: Queen Victoria Market (if Tuesday or weekend)
meals.description: Melbourne's famous market. Excellent vegetarian options — roast veggie wraps, falafel, souvlaki.

meals.name: Lune Croissanterie + Vegie Bar
meals.description: Lune for the world's best croissant (seriously). Then Vegie Bar in Fitzroy for a full vegetarian dinner — a Melbourne institution.

days.title: Melbourne to Hobart
days.neighborhoods: Melbourne → Hobart · Salamanca Place · Battery Point
days.description: Fly to Tasmania — Australia's island state. Cool, green, wild, and deeply distinctive. Hobart is a small city with a big cultural scene anchored by MONA.

activities.title: ✈️ Melbourne → Hobart
activities.description: 1-hour flight.

meals.name: Melbourne
meals.description: Quick breakfast before flight.

activities.title: 🏛️ Salamanca Place
activities.description: Sandstone warehouses converted into galleries, markets, restaurants, and bars. The Salamanca Market (Saturday only) is one of Australia's best outdoor markets.
details: 🛍️ Salamanca Market (Sat): local produce, art, buskers

activities.title: ⚓ Battery Point
activities.description: Hobart's historic village quarter. Winding lanes, cottages, and a proper British colonial feel. Arthur Circus is a tiny circular street of Georgian houses.

meals.name: Salamanca
meals.description: Lots of vegetarian options at the Salamanca cafés.

meals.name: Pigeon Hole (West Hobart)
meals.description: Excellent farm-to-table. Great vegetarian options from local producers.

days.title: MONA & Huon Valley
days.description: MONA (Museum of Old and New Art) is unlike any museum on Earth — a subterranean provocateur's playground. Then drive the Huon Valley for apple orchards and ancient forests.

activities.title: 🎨 MONA (Museum of Old and New Art)
activities.description: David Walsh's extraordinary private museum — built underground into a sandstone cliff on a peninsula above the Derwent. Confrontational, funny, beautiful, disturbing. Arrive by ferry (part of the experience).
details: 🛥️ MONA ROMA ferry from Hobart waterfront — adds to the magic
💡 The O app (free with admission) is brilliant — use it

meals.name: MONA Café
meals.description: The café is excellent. Vegetarian options.

activities.title: 🍎 Huon Valley
activities.description: Apple country. Ancient Huon pines (1000+ years old!), orchards, and the beautiful valley drive south from Hobart.
details: 📍 ~45 min south of Hobart · FREE to drive through
💡 Huon Apple & Heritage Festival (March) — or just enjoy the orchards

activities.title: 🏔️ Mount Wellington / kunanyi
activities.description: The mountain that watches over Hobart. Summit at 1270m — snow is possible in late May/June. Views are spectacular.
details: 📍 kunanyi/Mt Wellington · FREE · 30-min drive from CBD
💡 Check for snow/ice in June — summit can be 5-10°C colder than city

meals.name: Huon Valley
meals.description: Farm gate stall or café near Huonville.

meals.name: The Glass House (Salamanca)
meals.description: Wine bar and restaurant with great vegetarian options.

days.title: Tasmania East Coast — Freycinet
days.description: Drive to Tasmania's east coast. Freycinet is pure pink granite peaks, white sand, and impossibly blue water. Wineglass Bay is consistently ranked one of the world's top beaches.

activities.title: 🚗 Hobart → Freycinet
activities.description: ~2.5 hours northeast along the Tasman Highway. Beautiful coastal drive.

meals.name: Hobart
meals.description: Early start.

activities.title: 🏖️ Wineglass Bay Walk
activities.description: The Wineglass Bay Lookout walk (1 hr return) gives the famous aerial view of the perfect crescent bay. Descend to the beach (3 hrs return) to walk the white sand.
details: 📍 Freycinet NP · $30 park pass/vehicle · ~3 hrs to beach
💡 The lookout view alone is worth it — one of the world's great views
🌊 The water is crystal clear and cold (12-15°C in May/June)

activities.title: 🪨 Hazards Beach
activities.description: Less visited than Wineglass Bay but equally beautiful. Pink granite boulders, white sand, blue water.
details: 📍 Freycinet NP · ~4 hrs return walk from carpark

meals.name: Packed
meals.description: Bring lunch for the national park.

meals.name: Freycinet Marine Farm
meals.description: Oysters and seafood (they have vegetarian platters too) with harbour views.

tips.text: 💡 Freycinet is booked months ahead in summer. May/June is quieter — you may have the beach to yourself.

days.title: Port Arthur & Tasman Peninsula
days.neighborhoods: Port Arthur · Tasman Arch · Cape Hauy
days.description: The most intact convict site in the world. Port Arthur is hauntingly beautiful and deeply moving — a place where Australia's brutal colonial history is visible in stone.

activities.title: ⛓️ Port Arthur Historic Site
activities.description: UNESCO World Heritage. The main penitentiary, church ruins, hospital, and guard tower are extraordinary. The settlement was active 1830-1877 — 12,000 convicts transported here.
details: 📍 Port Arthur · $45/adult incl. harbour cruise + ghost tour
⏱️ Allow at least half a day
💡 The Isle of the Dead (convict cemetery island) boat tour is sobering and beautiful
🕯️ Ghost tours at night are genuinely excellent

meals.name: Port Arthur
meals.description: Café at the historic site.

activities.title: 🌊 Tasman Arch & Devil's Kitchen
activities.description: Extraordinary dolerite sea cliffs — some of the highest in the Southern Hemisphere. The Tasman Arch is a natural rock bridge. Devil's Kitchen is a collapsed cave with crashing surf far below.
details: 💡 Tessellated Pavement (geometric rock formation) is nearby — remarkable natural phenomenon

activities.title: 🦅 Cape Hauy Walk
activities.description: One of Tasmania's best day walks. Follows the cliff edge to The Totem Pole and Candlestick sea stacks. 6 km return, spectacular.

meals.name: Fortescue Bay Picnic
meals.description: Bring lunch for the walk.

meals.name: Hobart — Ethos Eat Drink
meals.description: Outstanding vegetarian restaurant in Hobart CBD.

days.title: Tasmania — Family & Wilderness
days.description: A treasured day with Tasmanian friends and family, and a chance to see more of this wild island.

activities.title: 🏔️ Cradle Mountain — Dove Lake Circuit
activities.description: If energy permits, drive to Cradle Mountain (2.5 hrs each way). The Dove Lake Circuit (6 km, 2-3 hrs) around the glacial lake with Cradle Mountain reflected in still water is one of Australia's greatest walks.
details: 📍 Cradle Mountain-Lake St Clair NP · $30 vehicle pass
💡 May/June = stunning autumn colours but check snow/ice forecast
⏱️ Full day with driving — early start 6 AM

activities.title: 🐨 Or: Bonorong Wildlife Sanctuary
activities.description: If Cradle Mountain is too far, Bonorong near Richmond is excellent — hand-feed kangaroos, see wombats, and the Tasmanian devil feeding sessions are extraordinary.
details: 💡 Tassie devils are genuinely bizarre and wonderful

meals.name: Hobart
meals.description: Early start whichever direction you go.

activities.title: 👨‍👩‍👧 Friends & Family in Tasmania
activities.description: Spend quality time with your Tassie connections. Let them take you to their secret spots — this is how you truly know a place.

meals.name: Family or Local Café
meals.description: Enjoy the company.

meals.name: Farewell Tasmania Dinner
meals.description: One last excellent meal in Hobart. Franklin Restaurant for wood-fired vegetarian dishes if budget allows.

days.title: Fly Home — Sydney Farewell
days.description: The final day. Fly back to Sydney to complete your extraordinary 46-day journey around Australia and New Zealand.

activities.title: 🌅 Final Hobart Morning
activities.description: A slow morning. Walk to the waterfront, grab a coffee at Salamanca, and watch the fishing boats.
details: 💡 Pick up local honey, lavender products, or Tasmanian whisky as gifts

meals.name: Jackman & McRoss (Battery Point)
meals.description: One of Hobart's best bakeries. Croissants, pastries, coffee.

activities.title: ✈️ Hobart → Sydney
activities.description: ~2-hour flight. You've done it.
details: 💡 You leave having seen more of Australia than most Australians ever will

meals.name: Airport or on arrival
meals.description: Transition meal.

activities.title: 🎉 Sydney — You Made It!
activities.description: 46 days. Two countries. Six Australian states plus the Northern Territory. New Zealand. Major natural wonders, cultural landmarks, ancient Indigenous sites, family connections, and one very meaningful grave visit in Auckland.
details: 🏆 Sydney Opera House, Great Barrier Reef, Uluru, Kakadu, Twelve Apostles, Whitehaven Beach, Freycinet, MONA, Blue Mountains, Daintree, Rangitoto, Te Papa, Weta Workshop — and so much more
💙 And Auckland: a great grandfather remembered across generations
💡 You deserve a very nice dinner tonight

meals.name: Quay or Aria (Sydney)
meals.description: Celebrate with a special dinner at one of Sydney's finest. Both have spectacular harbour views and excellent vegetarian menus.

tips.text: 💡 You've just completed one of the great travel experiences. Australia is vast — you've touched its heart in 46 extraordinary days.

budgetTable.notes: ~8-10 domestic flights. Book Jetstar 3-4 weeks ahead. Sydney↔NZ is biggest cost.
Mix of hostels ($35-50), Airbnbs ($70-120), and occasional motels ($90-150)
$25-45/day/person. Markets, cafés, occasional fine dining. Cooking some meals saves a lot.
GBR trip $220, Uluru park + tours $200, Kakadu $40, Scenic World $53, Weta $49, MONA $35, Port Arthur $45, etc.
Car hire for QLD coast, Great Ocean Road, and Tasmania legs. Fuel costs for long drives.
Travel insurance (essential!), SIM cards, laundry, shopping, unexpected costs
Budget end possible with hostel beds and self-catering. $5k is comfortable for 2 sharing costs.

practicalInfo.title: 🛂 Visas & Entry
items: New Zealand: Australian citizens enter visa-free. Other nationalities: NZ Electronic Travel Authority (NZeTA) required — apply online, NZ$23.
Australia: Most visitors need an ETA (Electronic Travel Authority) or eVisitor visa. Apply at immi.homeaffairs.gov.au. US/UK/EU citizens typically get the eVisitor (subclass 651) — free and instant.
NZ biosecurity is strict: declare ALL food items, including sealed packets. Fines are significant.
Australian biosecurity: same strict rules. Fruit, vegetables, honey, seeds, animal products must be declared.

practicalInfo.title: 📱 SIM Cards & Connectivity
items: Australia: Telstra has the best rural coverage (essential for the NT and outback). $30-50 for a prepaid month. Buy at the airport or any 7-Eleven.
New Zealand: Spark or Vodafone. $30 for a month of data. Available at airports.
Uluru, Kakadu, and remote areas: Telstra only. Optus and Vodafone don't work outside major highways.
Download offline maps (Google Maps or Maps.me) for all regions before leaving cities.

practicalInfo.title: 💊 Health & Insurance
items: Travel insurance is ESSENTIAL. Medical care in Australia is excellent but expensive without insurance.
Reciprocal healthcare: UK and Irish citizens have a reciprocal agreement with Australia. NZ citizens covered in both countries.
Sun protection: Australian UV is extreme. SPF50+, reapply every 2 hours. A hat is not optional.
Reef-safe sunscreen: essential for any reef snorkelling — check the bottle (no oxybenzone/octinoxate).
Vaccinations: No required vaccinations, but be up to date on routine vaccines.

practicalInfo.title: 🌿 Respecting Country
items: DO NOT CLIMB ULURU. It is permanently closed (Oct 2019) and climbing is deeply offensive to the Anangu people.
In Kakadu and other Aboriginal lands: some areas and objects are sacred. Respect all signage about photography restrictions.
The Daintree sits on Kuku Yalanji Country. Seek out Indigenous-led tours — the Dreamtime Walk at Mossman Gorge is excellent.
Leave No Trace in all national parks. Take all rubbish out. Don't pick wildflowers or move rocks.
Dingoes on Fraser Island are wild animals. They look like dogs but have fatally attacked children. Keep 5m distance, never feed them.
